objective: Capture every public-safe fragment with a disposition, mature sources into bounded observations and claims, preserve unselected depth, and project only audience-relevant claims with traceable evidence.

criteria.label: Lossless public-safe intake
criteria.intent: Every supplied fragment receives a stable ID, project association, disposition, boundary, and next relationship rather than disappearing silently.

criteria.label: Observation atomicity
criteria.intent: Sources are decomposed into proposition-level observations with locators, limitations, and explicit links to claims or research questions.

criteria.label: Evidence scope integrity
criteria.intent: Every source records what it establishes and does not establish; evidence relationships never silently broaden a source.

criteria.label: Claim maturation
criteria.intent: Defensible claims carry evidence, boundaries, anti-claims, review data, and open inquiries where material uncertainty remains.

criteria.label: Projection discipline
criteria.intent: Epistemic readiness remains separate from compositional selection; held claims have no public surface and active claims have an authorized page plan.

criteria.label: Existing-site evidence coverage
criteria.intent: The framework improves support for consequential claims already represented on the public site, without overloading the composition.

criteria.label: Public safety and collective credit
criteria.intent: No private locator or raw archive leaks; participant detail, policy causation, and collective outcomes remain explicitly bounded.

criteria.label: Recomposition and feedback readiness
criteria.intent: Unselected claims and open questions remain usable for future applications, site arguments, collaborator proofs, and photo-editor feedback loops.

criteria.label: Actor, action, purpose, result, and collective credit
criteria.intent: Contribution records make each actor, action, purpose, result, source, and boundary explicit while separating Jamie's work, shared work, coalition action, and institutional enactment.

criteria.label: Campaign press archive completeness
criteria.intent: Every press-list appearance across the four campaign sites is preserved with campaign provenance, deduplicated article identity, availability context, scope boundaries, and a maturation disposition.

criteria.label: Project social archive and attributable engagement
criteria.intent: Every recovered project account has a governed relationship; promoted engagement counts resolve to named public evidence, official-role checks, bounded methods, collective-credit limits, and explicit stopping conditions.

criteria.label: CallNYC full-population archival production
criteria.intent: All 110 profile-reported population slots have explicit dispositions; recovered content, posted URLs, issue distribution, engagement identities, source roles, unresolved records, and projection boundaries remain complete, reproducible, and non-inflationary.

criteria.label: WOW List full-population archival production
criteria.intent: All 38 profile-reported objects, 35 posted URLs, historical workflows, source roles, account-owned engagement, bounded external adoption, authorship limits, and selective projection remain complete, reproducible, and non-inflationary.

criteria.label: NYC Artist Coalition retrievable-population archival production
criteria.intent: Every record in the 3,123-record retrievable public union, all posted URLs, mission classifications, source-network appearances, bounded incoming response, access-time engagement, platform limits, shared authorship, and the 2,001-record owner-archive gap remain complete, replayable, public-safe, and non-inflationary.

criteria.label: Urbanhermit full live-profile population archival production
criteria.intent: All 434 capture-date live-profile records, all 321 posted short URLs, source authorship, mission classifications, bounded incoming response, visible interaction ownership, personal-context exclusions, mature source findings, owner-archive boundary, and selective non-projection remain complete, replayable, public-safe, and non-inflationary.

criteria.label: KC Town Hall full-population archival production
criteria.intent: All 183 surviving profile objects, every posted URL, all repost-bearing account statuses, stakeholder relationship types, service-workflow classifications, official-at-date checks, privacy boundaries, and selective projection remain complete, reproducible, and non-inflationary.

criteria.label: KC Town Hall field-practice evidence maturation
criteria.intent: Participant memory, protected proposal evidence, neighborhood-service archives, and public composition remain distinct: project-level facts mature, individual-role and completion propositions stay held, and sensitive source material never enters the public repository.

criteria.label: NYC Artist Coalition Facebook event archival production
criteria.intent: Every displayed past-event control slot has a disposition; all 33 exposed event records, source routes, venue and stakeholder interfaces, response-label boundaries, Jamie's attributed role, collective credit, transient availability, protected details, and the unresolved owner-export gap remain complete, auditable, public-safe, and non-inflationary.

criteria.label: Personal and WOW List Facebook event archival production
criteria.intent: All 511 personal-profile event-card instances and the zero-card current WOW List owner surface have explicit public-safe dispositions; selected Jamie-attributed records, source routes, Sunday Dinner milestones, early participatory-practice leads, response semantics, profile-association limits, private-data exclusions, and historical-zero boundaries remain complete, auditable, and non-inflationary.

criteria.label: WOW List Facebook post full-population archival production
criteria.intent: All 57 posts exposed by the capture-date authenticated live feed, all 55 posted URLs, displayed source relationships, organizer workflows, care and civic routing, interaction semantics, collective credit, raw-data exclusions, native-export limits, and selective non-projection remain complete, auditable, public-safe, and non-inflationary.

criteria.label: NYC Artist Coalition Facebook post full-population archival production
criteria.intent: All 445 posts exposed by the capture-date authenticated Page feed and all 67 cleaned off-Facebook routes remain reconciled, source-governed, mission-classified, privacy-preserving, and resistant to lifetime-history, individual-authorship, incoming-engagement, endorsement, traction, causation, and collective-credit inflation while the website receives only a selective aggregate projection.

criteria.label: Human corroboration blind-spot control
criteria.intent: The absence of governed first-hand collaborator testimony remains explicit, cannot be filled by AI review or participant memory, and has a permissioned corroboration protocol with a stopping rule.

criteria.label: Population denominator blind-spot control
criteria.intent: Every completeness claim stays bounded to a surface, account, capture date, and denominator; owner-export gaps remain open and not recovered never becomes did not exist.

criteria.label: Collective review blind-spot control
criteria.intent: Formal collaborator review remains distinct from structured credit rules and includes correction, qualification, and dissent without converting silence into approval or review into endorsement.

criteria.label: Recent operations blind-spot control
criteria.intent: Uneven public evidence for recent paid technical operations has a protected, end-to-end research protocol that distinguishes delivered work, operating methods, proposals, and outcomes.

criteria.label: Outcome evidence blind-spot control
criteria.intent: Activity, output, outcome, and impact remain separate evidence levels; attendance, press, and social response cannot become impact or sole causation by rhetorical promotion.

criteria.label: Role positioning blind-spot control
criteria.intent: Technical project management, product operations, and implementation each receive an explicit proof map while all variants retain the same governed facts and await real-reader confirmation.

criteria.label: Hiring usability blind-spot control
criteria.intent: The absence of unfamiliar hiring-reader sessions remains explicit and a task-based, consented, aggregate-only protocol cannot be passed with simulated human results.

criteria.label: Job funnel blind-spot control
criteria.intent: Application-funnel learning has a private event model and a de-identified aggregate projection boundary without exposing employers, contacts, correspondence, or asserting portfolio causation.

criteria.label: External validity blind-spot control
criteria.intent: Deterministic checks, mutation tests, and LLM judges remain internal evidence and cannot be presented as real-human understanding, hiring impact, or external validation.

criteria.label: Visual evidence blind-spot control
criteria.intent: Every projected image requires rights, consent, provenance, caption, and evidentiary-function decisions; archive custody and visual drama cannot supply permission, role, or outcome.

criteria.label: Voice and human stakes blind-spot control
criteria.intent: Motive, relationship, learning, and specificity remain visible without fabricated anecdotes, quotations, motives, emotional states, or loss of epistemic boundaries.

iteration: Run deterministic checks and a fresh editorial judge against the current bank.
Select the lowest criterion and state one bounded maturation hypothesis.
Improve structure, research, or projection without deleting protected boundaries.
Rerun checks, public-safety validation, and the affected public projection.
Keep only iterations that improve the lowest criterion without regressions.
antiGaming: Never call a memory a verified claim without a source relationship.
Never improve completeness by placing private paths or raw evidence in the public repo.
Never improve projection coverage by publishing every mature claim.
Never infer sole causation from participation, proximity, or contemporaneous coverage.
Never turn advocacy, testimony, participation, or coalition work into legislative enactment or sole causation.
Never treat a photograph as self-interpreting proof or consent to publish.
Never treat an instrumented blind spot as resolved.
Never synthesize collaborator testimony, real-human usability results, funnel outcomes, or publication permissions.
Never treat deterministic or LLM eval success as evidence of hiring impact.
hillClimb.stopWhen: Every criterion meets its minimum and the weighted target passes in two consecutive fresh-judge runs, with deterministic checks and public safety passing.
